**Self-audit result:** prior code at PR #712 and exact-head 453 tests addresses P3 custody *only*. It does **not** qualify #717 IC1–IC8 or R1–R6. Issue and draft titles are manual, PR sync absent, Owner intent stored on #717 only (not losslessly in #600), missing integrated cold-agent acceptance fixture and effective review checklist. Previously reported green tests must not be relabelled as integration PASS.

**Authority:** user demand authorizes returning integration to the governing roadmap/issue acceptance; it does not alter V3.2 frozen files, Local review/merge ownership, native #438/#604 custody truth, or permit PR #712 merge. Next: create an independent bounded R1 integration responsibility; preserve upstream P3 semantic blocker, but do not allow it to excuse absent source-link/fixture/renderer governance.
